name: Method invoking (through name)
goalName: Create a method where a string parameter is used to specify which method is invoked while taking expendability into account
goal: When I was working on my virtual personal assistant, I noticed my commands were very inefficient in adding them. I had to create the method and specify the name in the voice recognition and the "RunCommand" method. There must be a way to automatically add a command when the method is added.
